| `skills.weaponry.pool` | true or false | `false` |
| `skills.weaponry.shipUnits` | [integer >= 0, integer >= 0] | - |
| `skills.weaponry.stacking` | one of `best`, `sum`, `each` | `"best"` |
| `skills.weaponry.units` | [integer >= 0, integer >= 0] | `[3,6]` |
| `skills.weaponry.value` | object, checked by the game | `{"kind":"perLevel","x2":[10,15]}` |
| `travel` | object |  |
| `travel.turns` | integer >= 0 | `5` |

`append`, `insertAfter` and `removeValue` rows apply to the list fields: `levels.thresholds`, `price.techUnits`, `skills`, `skills.assassin.effects`, `skills.commando.effects`, `skills.diplomat.effects`, `skills.engineer.effects`, `skills.environmentalist.effects`, `skills.famous.effects`, `skills.farming_leader.effects`, `skills.fighter_pilot.effects`, `skills.financial_leader.effects`, `skills.galactic_lore.effects`, `skills.helmsman.effects`, `skills.instructor.effects`, `skills.labor_leader.effects`, `skills.medicine.effects`, `skills.megawealth.effects`, `skills.navigator.effects`, `skills.operations.effects`, `skills.ordnance.effects`, `skills.researcher.effects`, `skills.science_leader.effects`, `skills.security.effects`, `skills.spiritual_leader.effects`, `skills.spy_master.effects`, `skills.tactics.effects`, `skills.telepath.effects`, `skills.trader.effects`, `skills.weaponry.effects`.

Keyed arrays: the path segment after the array names an element by its key field, then the element's field (`skills.<key>.<field>`). Rows on an element never conflict with rows on another element; a row on the whole array conflicts with both.

- `skills` by `key` (any element key): `category`, `effects`, `frozenInactive`, `inert`, `pool`, `shipUnits`, `stacking`, `units`, `value`
